description: Get decrypted secret value by key. Requires vault to be unlocked. Use sparingly - prefer resolve_with_secrets on address book for structured access.
embedding_description: Vault: retrieve a secret. Decrypts + returns the plaintext value (password / credential / API key / OAuth client_secret / refresh+bearer token) for a named vault key. Requires unlocking. Use sparingly — prefer address_book::resolve_with_secrets which keeps plaintext out of the agent's conversation. Direct retrieve is correct only when the agent genuinely needs cleartext.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Decrypted secret value. Contains key (identifier) and value (decrypted). SECURITY: Handle with care - contains sensitive data.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Decrypts and retrieves a secret value from the vault. Requires vault to be unlocked with correct passphrase.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultLocked: Vault must be unlocked before retrieving secrets. KeyNotFound: No secret exists with the specified key. DecryptionError: Internal error - vault may be corrupted.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultLocked: Prompt user to unlock vault first. For KeyNotFound: List available secrets or check key spelling. For DecryptionError: Serious issue - suggest checking vault integrity.
